profile.headline: Python Backend & AI Developer
profile.shortBio: I am working on becoming a professional Python developer, designing high-performance asynchronous backends for FastAPI, flexible SQLAlchemy databases, and reliable multi-agent AI systems that adhere to strict protocols.

sections.heading: About & Professional Vision
sections.leadParagraph: I’m a Python Backend & AI Developer based in Accra, Ghana. I genuinely love untangling complex problems and building clean, modular systems that make a real, positive impact on people's lives.
paragraphs: Rather than just writing basic glue code, I focus on engineering resilient backend infrastructure using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0, and Asyncio. On the AI side, I build multi-agent workflows with Google ADK, using strict Pydantic V2 schemas and Enums to keep things reliable and completely hallucination-free.

sections.heading: Services & Value Proposition
sections.intro: What I deliver to companies, clients, and engineering teams with guaranteed engineering metrics:

items.title: High-Performance FastAPI Backend Architecture
items.description: Design and implementation of non-blocking backend microservices with automatic OpenAPI interactive documentation, bulletproof authentication, and granular RBAC authorization.
items.guarantee: Sub-100ms response latencies, zero thread starvation, and comprehensive audit logging.

items.title: Multi-Agent AI Systems & LLM Governance
items.description: Architecting multi-agent generative loops via Google ADK and leading LLMs (Gemini, Claude), constrained by strict behavioral constitutions and Pydantic validation barriers.
items.guarantee: Zero uncontrolled hallucinations, schema-compliant outputs, and graceful fallback handling.

items.title: Database Architecture & SQLAlchemy Foundations
items.description: Establishing normalized relational schemas, non-blocking connection lifecycles, and generic base repository abstractions for PostgreSQL and SQLite.
items.guarantee: Zero N+1 query leaks, clean migration history via Alembic, and scalable domain isolation.

items.title: Python Technical Training & Mentorship
items.description: Structured engineering mentoring for developers and teams, progressing from algorithmic fundamentals and memory models to advanced asynchronous architectures.
items.guarantee: Transforming theoretical understanding into production-ready logical and modular code.

sections.heading: Featured Projects & Experience
sections.intro: A selection of flagship projects and roles showcasing hands-on leadership in backend systems, AI orchestration, and developer education:

items.title: Child's Nest — AI Behavioral Modification Platform
items.description: Engineered a multi-stage sequential agent system utilizing Google ADK to generate deeply personalized, interactive behavioral stories for children. Developed real-time WebSocket communication pipelines via FastAPI emulating a Gemini Live interaction loop, delivering instant feedback that actively shapes and reinforces positive child behaviors while adhering to rigorous safety guardrails.

items.title: FastAPI Base Foundation — Production Enterprise Starter
items.description: Architected a reusable enterprise backend foundation to standardize production FastAPI applications with zero code duplication. Incorporates a unified BaseRepository pattern with SQLAlchemy 2.0 AsyncSession, robust JWT authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), structured JSON audit logging, and strict domain-driven separation between core infrastructure and business modules.

items.title: Python Instructor — Technical Leadership & Mentorship
items.description: Conducted intensive technical training programs mentoring aspiring engineers in Python fundamentals, data structures, functional paradigms, and server concurrency. Instilled rigorous code-review habits, Google-style docstrings, structural typing, and clean architectural patterns to cultivate autonomous software engineers.
